rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent stepped compact mass with a single dominant rule and good repair integrity across the four views. It is clearly contained within the parcel and the silhouette is legible in all views, so it avoids the one-view-only and collision failures. However, it is still largely a sealed, object-like stepped block: the verified road edge is acknowledged only weakly, with no meaningful public void, court, undercut, or entry seam at the frontage. For neighborhood living / 근린생활시설 this keeps the form barely acceptable rather than strongly resolved. The upper setback language resonates with the similar references and with the counterfactual only at the level of hierarchy, but the core program demand for an active ground threshold is underrepresented.
